text_block_list.text: As I'm passing by the stress stump...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
HRAAAH! C'MON! MAKE ME ONE OF
THE
STARS ALREADYYY!
Eek! You heard that?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: What in the world are you doing?

text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... Isn't this where we're
supposed to yell
all our troubles away?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I was just trying to get over a race I had
recently...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heh! ♪ Looks like the great Токай Тэйо has crushed yet another scrimmage!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Everything was perfect! I had the win in
the bag!
But that darn Teio just had to...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Dang it, dang it, dang it! I can't believe this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...So, yeah. I just really wanted to vent
my
frustration.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But I just feel more embarrassed than
anything.
What's a background extra
like me doing trying
to have a character
arc, huh? Ahahaha...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well now, what's this? I figured Helios
was out
rantin' again, but it's just you,
Nature.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... You're still hung up on
losing to
Teio?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Palmer... Hmph. No comment.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
C'mon now, don't be like that. I know
just how
you feel, but you won't get
anywhere pouting like
that. You just
need to outrun your weaker self!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, are you saying I should face
her
head-on?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, nah. I mean you've gotta ditch
the
"ordinary" and start thinking about
the
"extraordinary"!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Just imagine escaping into a world of
positivity
where you stand at the top
and reign as number
one. After all,
dreaming is free, right?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
...You say that, but I have no idea how
to picture
that!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Initially bewildered by what seems an
impossible
feat, Найс Нэйчер follows
Mejiro Palmer's advice
and manages to
unleash her imagination...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"She's done it! She won! And now... Nice
Nature
stands atop that glorious stage!"
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
"From this day on, I shall no longer be a
Bronze
Collector but a Gold Collector!"
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's the spirit! Now that's what I
call an
explosive escape from reality!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! No, no, no! There's no way I
could ever
show off like this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What're you getting all bashful
about? I'll
always be here for you if you
need anything.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
But hey, a little daydreaming did you
some good,
right? Now you can get back
to trying your best,
bit by bit! ♪
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, Palmer. That's easier said than
done!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But... I guess I can try it for a while.
Might as well
see what happens.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
